purpose: External audit of differing load-scaling observations. No new causal conclusions or performance measurements.

base.snapshotScope: All changed files plus selected core source; complete engine hash manifests at each stage. Public pinned base plus complete ordered patches reconstructs tested production source.

copyPolicy.rawNumericValues: Unchanged; all valid clean and ordinary samples retained. No selected-good-value filter.
copyPolicy.csv: Every copied frame-interval CSV is byte-identical to original.
copyPolicy.environment: Controller-authored curated experiment fields and actual selected child-mode receipts only; no complete process environment.
copyPolicy.originalAndPublishedHashes: Original SHA256 hashes the local frozen bytes before path normalization. Published SHA256 hashes the exact public copy. No hash is silently rewritten inside a historical result to pretend the bytes were unchanged.
copyPolicy.generatedArtifacts: Numbered complete patches, source manifests, numeric integrity report, this provenance, exclusions, INDEX and REPRODUCING are new archival/derived documents; their exact bytes are covered by final manifest.

contributors.policy: Credit actual additional work. Verbatim extraction of existing yeojuny code remains credited to yeojuny; independently authored or further corrected/redesigned portions by tomjn require his contribution credit. Preserve original authorship/provenance; do not invent emails.

contributions.scope: Add missing bindingIndex argument to the uniform/storage buffer invalid-index error messages. Only this two-call refinement imported; remaining existing native guards preserved.
contributions.provenance: Original pinned Recoil01efdf4 lines1406/1410 and archivedMVK lines1500/1504 already omit this argument. This is an inherited bug, not a regression introduced by178 or177.
contributions.requiredPublicCredit: LuaVBO invalid-index diagnostic correction adapted from tomjn/RecoilEngine PR3695, commit29b950671fd883d2e01bc2cf1f6f6d0b7168280a.

contributions.scope: Sync pool worker-entry USER_INITIATED hint. yeojuny adapted benbreen’s worker-entry idea for Small and preserved already-high QoS. Native candidate adds explicit opt-in, startup latching and bounded requested-class read-back.
contributions.requiredPublicCredit: macOS synchronous worker QoS is adapted from benbreen’s Apple Silicon Recoil work via yeojuny’s protected Small r57 adaptation.

contributions.scope: Bring in the macOS finite-mask SetAffinity USER_INTERACTIVE request and pthread/qos.h include. Keep zero/run-anywhere no-op semantics. The local Darwin save/restore guard already implements the upstream behavior. Restore the pure220 worker-entry object to avoid applying two QoS policies.
contributions.requiredPublicCredit: macOS thread-affinity QoS handling adapted from Tom J Nowell (tomjn), RecoilEngine PR #3035, including the run-anywhere mask refinement.
contributions.reviewStatus: PR open, aggregate APPROVED, sprunk reviewed ad162828; later run-anywhere guard from PR head ac1ea236. Explicit user authorization to adopt.
